sn3.24:1.2: nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.24:1.3: Kattha nu kho bhante dānaṃ dātabban ti || || 3.
sn3.24:1.4: Yattha kho mahārāja cittam pasīdatī ti || || 4.
sn3.24:1.5: Kattha pana bhante dinnam mahapphalan ti || || 5.
sn3.24:1.6: Aññaṃ kho etaṃ mahārāja kattha dānaṃ dātabbaṃ || aññam pan-etaṃ kattha dinnam mahapphalan ti || ||
sn3.24:1.7: Sīlavato kho mahārāja dinnam mahapphalaṃ no tathā dussīle || ||
sn3.24:1.8: Tena hi mahārāja taññ-ev-ettha paripucchissāmi || yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi || 6.
sn3.24:1.10: Idha tyassa yuddham paccupaṭṭhitam saṅgāmo samupabbuḷho || ||
sn3.24:1.11: Atha āgaccheyya khattiya-kumāro asikkhito akata-hattho akata-yoggo akat- upāsano bhīrū chambhī utrāsī palāyī ||
sn3.24:1.12: bhareyyāsi taṃ purisaṃ attho ca te tādisena purisena || || 7.
sn3.24:1.13: Nāham bhante bhareyyaṃ taṃ purisaṃ na ca me attho tādisena purisenā ti || || 8.
sn3.24:1.17: na ca me attho tādisena purisenā ti || 9.
sn3.24:2.2: Idha tyassa yuddhaṃ paccupaṭṭhitam saṅgāmo samupabbūḷho || ||
sn3.24:2.3: Atha āgaccheyya khattiya-kumāro sikkhito kata-hattho kata-yoggo kat-upāsano abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī
sn3.24:2.4: bhareyyāsi taṃ purisaṃ attho ca te tādisena purisenā ti || || 10.
sn3.24:2.5: Bhareyyāham bhante tam purisam attho ca me tādisena purisenā ti || || 11.
sn3.24:2.8: Atha āgaccheyya sudda-kumāro sikkhito katahattho kata-yoggo kat-upāsano abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī ||
sn3.24:2.9: bhareyyāsi taṃ purisam attho ca te tādisena purisenā ti || || 12.
sn3.24:2.10: Bhareyyāhaṃ bhante tam purisam attho ca me tādisena purisenā ti || || 13.
sn3.24:3.1: Evam eva kho mahārāja yasmā kasmā ce pi kulā agarismā anagāriyam pabbajito hoti || so ca hoti pañcaṅgavippahīno pañcaṅga-samannāgato || tasmiṃ dinnam mahapphalaṃ || || 14.
sn3.24:3.3: Kāmacchando pahīno hoti || Vyāpādo pahīno hoti || Thīnamiddham pahīnaṃ hoti || Uddhacca-kukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti || Vicikicchā pahīnā hoti ||
sn3.24:3.6: asekkhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti || asekkhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti || asekkhena paññakkhandhena samannāgato hoti || asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgato hoti || asekkhena vimuttiññāna-dassana-kkhandhena samannāgato hoti || ||
sn3.24:3.8: Iti pañcaṅga-vippahīne pañcaṅga-sammannāgate dinnam mahapphalan ti || || 17.
sn3.24:10.6: dātāram abhivassatīti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānam || || 2. Ekam antaṃ
